name: 1Password
description: Resolve 1Password secrets in-process into the OpenClaw shared store, and expose 1Password vault/item tools to agents.

op.description: Advanced/optional. Resolves op:// references via a child node resolver. Subject to the exec secret sandbox — requires egress allowlisting to reach the 1Password API. Prefer the in-process store sync for most setups.

serviceAccountTokenEnvVar.description: Name of the environment variable holding the 1Password service account token.

integrationName.description: Integration name reported to the 1Password SDK for audit logs.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-operation timeout for 1Password SDK calls, in milliseconds.

syncOnStartup.description: Fetch the configured secrets from 1Password and sync them (store and/or file) when the gateway starts.

failFastOnStartup.description: If true, a startup sync failure (resolve, store write, or file write) throws and prevents the gateway from starting. If false, the plugin logs the error and falls back to last-known-good values.

secrets.description: Map of OpenClaw store key -> 1Password secret reference (op://Vault/Item[/Section]/Field). Store keys must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$. Referenced with source:'store'.

syncToFile.description: Resolve op:// references and write them to a JSON file that OpenClaw's source:'file' provider reads. For channels (e.g. Slack) that reject source:'store'. Independent of `secrets`; both can be active.

path.description: Absolute path of the JSON file to write. Keep it inside the OpenClaw data volume and out of any agent-readable path. Written 0600.

mode.description: File format. Only 'json' (flat object; SecretRef ids are JSON pointers like /KEY) is supported.

secrets.description: Map of file key -> 1Password secret reference. Keys must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$.
